notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites: There are at least three cards in your library.
description:
Cast Rules of Acquisition by paying {3}{U}{U}, drawing three cards and causing target opponent to gain control of Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
